clips.title: The story
paras: Around Mystral Lake, you find glowing globes of tainted water among the slain elementals. You carry a specimen to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post to learn what has poisoned the lake and its spirits.

Mystral Lake lies in south-central Ashenvale, and its water elementals have grown violently aggressive and visibly corrupted. When slain, they leave strange, intensely glowing spheres of putrid fluid instead of pure elemental essence. The globes hold the corruption that has settled over the lake, showing that something more than natural territorial aggression is at work.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The slain elemental has produced an intensely glowing globe of water. The contents of the globe are, at best, disgusting. It would be safe to assume that whatever has befouled the water of Mystral Lake is most likely present in the water of the globe.
It's not exactly common knowledge who might be interested in such a find; perhaps the person who originally sent you out to the lake, Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, might have an idea.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You find a nasty ball of water and decide to bring it to me? Who am I, the Earthen Ring or something?
Actually, that does give me an idea... Perhaps you do need the Earthen Ring for this. I mean, if it helps clear up the situation at the lake for good, then I'm all for it.
You know who the Earthen Ring are, friend?
